name: Cadence tracker + /achiri-health command
block: Phase 1.5 gate ops + Phase 2A alpha ops
goal: Two small high-value operator tools: (1) record-manual-post.ts now shows cadence needed (posts/day) after every record and list — directly helps Apr 7 gate; (2) /achiri-health Telegram command (owner-only) pings ACHIRI_BASE_URL/health and reports UP/DOWN + latency — essential for Apr 25 alpha day ops.
rationale: Apr 7 gate: 0/30 posts, 22 days remaining. Operator needs to know exact cadence needed after each post. record-manual-post.ts shows gate progress but not cadence. /achiri-health: Apr 25 alpha launch requires knowing Achiri server is up. Operator must ping /health from Telegram without SSH. Both are 1-function edits; direct write, no swarm.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 targeted function edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/record-manual-post.ts — cadence needed in printStatus()
tasks.description: In printStatus(), after the gate status line, compute and print cadence needed. APR_7 = new Date('2026-04-07'). daysToGate = Math.ceil((APR_7 - now) / 86400000). postsRemaining = max(0, POSTS_TARGET - totalPosts). neededPerDay = daysToGate > 0 ? (postsRemaining / daysToGate).toFixed(1) : 'NOW'. Print: '  Cadence needed: X posts/day (Y days to Apr 7 gate)'. If daysToGate <= 0: '  GATE DATE PASSED'. Also print this after recordPost() by calling printStatus(loadPosts()) at end of recordPost().

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/commands.ts — /achiri-health command
tasks.description: Add handleAchiriHealth() function: owner-only (chatId !== ownerChatId → send 'Not authorized.'). Fetch ACHIRI_BASE_URL + '/health' with 5000ms timeout (AbortController). On success: parse JSON, compute latency (Date.now() - start), send 'Achiri API: UP (Xms) — version Y'. On fetch error/timeout: send 'Achiri API: DOWN — <error message>'. Route '/achiri-health' in handleCommand() to handleAchiriHealth(). Add '/achiri-health — Achiri server status (owner)' to /help output in handleHelp().

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-sprint-138.ts — validation script
tasks.description: Check: (1) record-manual-post.ts contains 'Cadence needed' string; (2) record-manual-post.ts contains 'APR_7' or 'Apr 7' date logic; (3) commands.ts contains handleAchiriHealth function; (4) commands.ts routes '/achiri-health'; (5) handleAchiriHealth fetches /health endpoint; (6) /achiri-health appears in help text. All 6 checks must PASS. Exit 0 on pass, 1 on fail.

acceptance_criteria: record-manual-post.ts printStatus() prints cadence needed (posts/day + days to Apr 7)
